release.name: SMonitor 0.21.0
release.body:
# SMonitor 0.21.0

This release adds safe, audience-specific metadata templates for catalog diagnostics and a bounded, nonemitting identity bundle for support workflows.

## Changes

- Add opt-in `metadata_messages` and `metadata_hints` for `user`, `dev`, `qa`, and `agent` profiles. Metadata-only diagnostics use only validated safe templates ([#39](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/issues/39)).
- Add `collect_identity_bundle()` and `export_identity_bundle()` with fixed provenance and omission fields, bounded retained events, and an explicit code allowlist ([#40](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/issues/40)).
- Apply retained event-buffer size changes immediately, including size zero ([#41](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/issues/41)).
- Keep handler-degradation diagnostics available when warnings are treated as errors, and continue delivering events to later handlers ([#42](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/issues/42)).
- Guard exception diagnostics when argument `repr` fails ([#36](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/issues/36)); make the guide audit read-only and stop Conda builds after a failed version freeze ([#47](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/issues/47)).

## Qualification

- Source matrix: [12 successful OS/Python cells](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/actions/runs/38524363789).
- Staging build: [build and Windows command verification](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/actions/runs/38524561040).
- Installed artifact: [12 successful OS/Python cells](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/actions/runs/38525100772).
- Exact Conda file: `smonitor-0.21.0-py_2.tar.bz2`, SHA-256 `62b6cbae37f7fa06374af87923792f00253020955d000294b1a7d37eb9d04e56`.

optional_capabilities.audience_metadata: Explicit metadata_messages/metadata_hints for user/dev/qa/agent; debug uses dev. Selected audience then shared safe field fallback; ordinary hints are not implicitly safe. resolve does not emit or change application policy.
optional_capabilities.identity_bundle: Separate collect_identity_bundle/export_identity_bundle, max 100 retained events, max 128 application-approved codes, fixed producer/schema/time/coverage/omissions, no argv/paths/config/catalog/free-text payload, no handler calls or summary flush. Bounded incomplete history and fingerprint correlation remain visible.
optional_capabilities.compatibility: Existing rich exports, shared metadata defaults, bootstrap defaults and floors for earlier capabilities remain unchanged.
fixes: Immediate retained-buffer capacity reduction, including zero.
Handler-degradation warnings treated as errors do not stop later handlers.
Exception diagnostic fallback tolerates failing argument repr.
Read-only guide audit and abort after failed version freeze.

argdigest_32.evidence_scope: Owner reports private development wheel on Linux/Python 3.14.8, 390 pass/one sibling-source collective omission against exact public SMonitor 0.21.0/DepDigest 0.15.1. Public ArgDigest candidate/Conda/platform qualification remains pending; not independently rerun here.

consumer_dispositions.recorda_24: Open; installed shared-workspace Recorda 0.3.0 metadata still requires smonitor>=0.19,<0.20. Provider receiving/bound remains owner-selected through MOLI #62; shared environment unchanged.
